adjudication.rationale: The diff does show synchronous feed polling during per-URL embed retrieval: in lib/topic_retriever.rb `perform_retrieve` calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` inline when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, before falling back to HTTP fetch. The throttling in `retrieved_recently?` is keyed by `@embed_url` (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`), so many distinct embed URLs can each bypass each other’s throttle and trigger a full feed fetch/parse + scan (`Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` opens and parses the entire feed and iterates `rss.items`). This is a concrete scalability/architecture concern grounded in the diff, though not a direct correctness/security defect.
